effects: Your maximum life points are reduced by 25%.

body.name: Havoc Born

assumptions: The damage multiplier uses the shared final post-hit pipeline for direct, damage-over-time, poison, conjure, command, proc, attached, reflected, and blessing-generated damage.

Empowered Tuska's Wrath keeps its fixed 100x Slayer damage and 15,000 cap, excludes ordinary ability-damage and other normal CombatModifier stages, and admits Havoc Born as the global final-damage multiplier.
The Slayer-50 fixed-hit case is the below-cap verification case: 5,000 without Havoc Born and 6,000 with Havoc Born under this model.
The multiplier uses shared stepwise rounding and is applied once to each pipeline damage instance.
Maximum life and total Armour are reduced in final derived stages after additive stat bonuses and other positive blessing multipliers.
excluded: Ability-damage and other ordinary CombatModifier stages on empowered Tuska's Wrath

reason: Resolve the fixed empowered Tuska interaction without reopening ordinary ability modifiers.

effects: Your basic attacks trigger Light of Saradomin 5x at random tiles near your target, each damaging up to 8 targets within 1 tile.
Light of Saradomin deals 2% increased damage for each point of Prayer bonus you have.
Light of Saradomin now heals you for 5% of damage dealt.
body.name: Lord of Light

assumptions: Only post-modernisation Basic Attacks trigger the effect; ordinary basic abilities and legacy autoattacks do not.
The five Light strikes inherit Striking Light's disclosed 40-60% ability damage plus 250% armour formula; Lord of Light does not restate a different base formula.
Prayer bonus multiplies each Light hit after its ability-damage and armour terms. Each strike uses the selected target count in the area scenario, capped at 8.

With areaTargets:1, the calculator resolves five Light events against one selected target; primary-target inclusion by every random tile is not proven by the static reveal text and remains an in-game verification case.
With areaTargets greater than 1, target count and overlap are deterministic scenario inputs rather than a spatial tile simulation.
Lord of Light and Striking Light have independent cooldowns. Lord's Prayer scaling and 5% healing apply to either source's Light of Saradomin hit.

Each Light is a separate crit-eligible hit. Healing floors 5% of each Light event's expected damage, matching the project's expected-value convention; this is not the expected value of flooring each possible actual damage outcome.
excluded: Random tile placement and per-target overlap for multi-target output
Primary-target inclusion for random areas until live in-game verification

reason: Clarify inherited Light mechanics, expected-value healing, and scenario-dependent spatial support.
